notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

skipped.reason: Birth circumstances (cord, twins, nurses): needs navamsa and sign classes; of little use in a report.
Body marks and injuries by decanate: medical, excluded.

variants.text: The ascendant lord is with a malefic or in the 6th, 8th or 12th: physical ease and comfort are reduced.
The ascendant lord is in an angle or trine: lasting physical comfort.
The ascendant lord is combust, debilitated or in an enemy's sign: health needs more care.
Benefics in angles or trines from the ascendant protect health.

rules.text: The ascendant or the Moon is under malefic influence with no benefic aspect: health and comfort are not easily enjoyed.

variants.text: A benefic in the ascendant: good looks and physical comfort.
Only malefics in the ascendant: appearance is less favoured.
A benefic aspects the ascendant: physical comfort.

rules.text: The ascendant lord, Mercury, Jupiter or Venus in an angle or trine: wealthy, intelligent and favoured by those in authority.

variants.text: The ascendant lord in a movable sign with a benefic aspect: fame, wealth and abundant comfort.
Benefics with the Moon in the ascendant, or in angles: marks of distinction.

rules.text: Reading principle: the same results should also be judged taking the Moon's sign as the ascendant.
rules.note: Guidance only; it has no chart condition, so the report does not show it.
